Kit summary

Venomous Sand ScarActive
Deals 400% ATK Poison DMG to one enemy and applies 1 layer of Sinking Sand Mark (-5% SPD per layer, max 4).
Solar-Lunar CycleActive
Gains 1 Solar Sigil, then deals 300% ATK Poison DMG to all enemies. If Solar ≥ Lunar Sigils, enemy skill CDs +1 turn; if Lunar > Solar, enemy Turn Meter -10%.
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.1Also casts Venomous Sand Pursuit, deals 500% more DMG to Bosses, and is cast automatically when allies damage a Boss (up to 2 times before her turn).
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.3CD is reduced by 1 turn and she gains 10% Turn Meter for every 2 Lunar Sigils gained.
Mirage Sand HuntPassive
Starts battle with Desert Holy Crown (immune to control and Turn Meter reduction, 1 turn) and 3 Solar Sigils. Each Solar and Lunar Sigil gives +5% ATK and +10% Mastery (max 6 each). When an enemy ends its turn without casting a skill, she casts Venomous Sand Pursuit: spends 1 Solar to deal AoE Poison DMG (200% ATK + 100% per Lunar Sigil), poisons all enemies and gains 1 Lunar. Enemies reaching 4 Sinking Sand Marks get Sandstorm Hex (-50% Crit DMG and Mastery); at 4 marks while hexed they skip their turn (up to 3 times before she acts).
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.1Gaining Solar resets Holy Crown to 2 turns and converts Mastery into Effect Hit (+0.5% per 1%, up to +150%). Pursuit ignores DMG Immunity at 3+ Lunar Sigils.
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.2Pursuit also fires on ally Direct DMG, ally control, enemy turn skips and 5 enemy DoTs, adding Sinking Sand Marks each time. Spending Solar heals 300% ATK. Gains 100% Turn Meter after the fastest ally acts (once per battle). Two different allies dealing Direct DMG gives her 20% Turn Meter and Veil of Sacred Night.
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.3With 5 Control allies deployed, starts battle with Veil of Sacred Night (all allies' Crit DMG taken becomes 1 for 1 turn).
Lunar Eclipse RebirthActive
Applies 1 Sinking Sand Mark to all enemies (not Bosses). Deals 3 hits of 200% ATK Poison DMG to all enemies, +10% per Lunar Sigil. At 6 Lunar Sigils, consumes them to ignore Shield and DMG Immunity and grants 6 Solar Sigils.
Mystic Sand Scepter Lv.3First cast grants 3 Solar Sigils and inflicts Sandstorm Hex plus 2 marks on all enemies. Every cast gives allies ATK Up II (2 turns). CD reduced per 2 Lunar Sigils gained. With 5 Poison allies deployed, also gives Mastery Up II and SPD Up II (4 turns), deals 500% more DMG to Bosses and strips their buffs.
Mystic Sand Scepter (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

At max level
Uplifting Drums
Uplifting Drums

Increases all allies' ATK by 7% when a battle starts.

If an ally is inflicted with Block Removal, the ally will gain 1 layer of Energizing Notes at the end of the following 3 turns, up to 1 layer can be gained at the end of each turn. Each layer of Energizing Notes increases ATK by 1.4%, up to 40 layers. This effect will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.

Additionally, when an ally is inflicted with Block Removal in their first 3 turns each wave, there is a 100% chance to gain 1 extra layer. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.

If the same Echo is equipped by multiple allies at the same time in a battle, only one of them will take effect.

At max level
Golden Sand Reverie
Golden Sand Reverie

Increases the owner's Skill DMG by 21%.

If the owner is from Sunset Sages:

1. Can trigger up to 4 times per battle: if an enemy does not proactively cast a skill during their turn, grants 1 layer of Mirage Sandguard to all allies (reduces DMG taken to 1 and removes 1 layer after taking Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG).

2. When the owner deals Poison DMG outside of their own turn, increases their Poison DMG dealt by 2%, up to 25 layers.
